say: Set a provisional gate of €15 monthly contribution per hotel—60% of the proposed €25 price—after payment fees, other variable costs and every human minute valued at a declared replacement wage. This is a management hurdle, not an evidence-backed market benchmark. Barely positive margin leaves too little room for acquisition, overhead and disruption spikes. At the supplied standard EEA-card rate, a hypothetical €25 payment costs €0.625, leaving €9.375 for labor and other variable costs if you retain €15.
